facts.label: Wild Growth (Restoration)
facts.value: Wild Growth has 1 rank and sits on row 7, column 2 of the Restoration tree. It requires Living Spirit. In use: 550 Mana, 40 yd range, 3 sec cast, 6 sec cooldown.
